content.short: LBank is a global crypto exchange with 20M+ users, known for early listings of new tokens.
content.description: LBank is a cryptocurrency exchange founded in 2015 that has grown to more than 20 million registered users, offering spot and futures trading and frequent early listings of new and meme tokens. Stable's official ecosystem page lists LBank.
content.meta: LBank is a global crypto exchange with 20M+ users and early token listings, listed on Stable.
